What is the main thing which is driving the force between the centrifugal force and centrifugal force?

The main force involved is actually the centripetal force, which pulls inward and keeps an object moving in a circle; the centrifugal force is only an apparent outward force seen in a rotating frame.[4][2] In simple terms, the outward feeling comes from inertia, while the inward force is what truly drives circular motion.[5][13]
